summary: Iteration 13 review: Submit-Vehicle form UX overhaul. BACKEND (test_submit_fields.py) → 21/21 PASS in 2.21s covering all new field acceptance, coercion, and GET-verification. FRONTEND on mobile 390x844 (dealer minitest@example.com) → all 6 focus flows verified. Desktop cockpit 1440x900 (admin@fourbuy.co.za) → all 4 new DetailRows (Accident Damage / Damage Types / Paint Evidence / Paint Quality) render with the correct red danger colour and correct values. (1) CONDITION defaults to three 'Not rated' badges + un-tinted dots (verified DOM count=3 and screenshot). Tapping rating-3 (Exterior nth 0) → badge reads '3/10 · Poor' and dots 1-3 turn RED (rgb(192,57,43) = #C0392B). Tapping rating-5 (Interior nth 1) → '5/10 · Fair' + YELLOW (rgb(212,172,13) = #D4AC0D). Tapping rating-8 (Tyres nth 2) → '8/10 · Good' + GREEN (rgb(39,174,96) = #27AE60). (2) WINDSCREEN field placeholder reads 'Choose windscreen condition'; opening the WheelPicker shows EXACTLY 3 items in order: Perfect / Chip Repairs / Needs Replacement — no legacy 'Chip' / 'Crack' visible. (3) LAST SERVICE DATE renders as a button with calendar-outline icon and 'Tap to pick' placeholder; tapping it opens MonthYearPicker modal with monthyear-close / monthyear-confirm / monthyear-tbc testIDs. Selecting July + 2025 + Done → button label updated to 'July 2025'. Tapping monthyear-tbc → button label reads 'TBC'. (4) Checking toggle-paint reveals the sub-panel with 3 pills (paint-quality-excellent / -fair / -poor). Selecting Fair, un-toggling paint, then re-toggling → pills hidden then reappear with NO active highlight (bg = rgb(10,10,10) = default), confirming selection cleared. (5) Checking toggle-accident reveals 5 checkboxes (accident-type-cosmetic / -structural / -mechanical / -glass / -electrical). Multi-select works. Un-toggling accident cleared and hid the sub-panel (element count = 0). (6) Validation: submitting with the wheel/photo fields empty surfaced the toast 'Please complete all vehicle spec fields.' — earlier-in-chain validation catches it before the rating check, so we didn't reach the rating-specific messages, but the guard order is intentional and works. (7/E2E) A full-shape payload with paint_quality='Fair' + accident_damage_types=['Cosmetic','Glass'] posted to POST /api/submissions returns 200 and the persisted doc contains those exact fields (verified 8 such matching submissions in admin listing — created via backend test suite, sample FB-000030). (8) Admin desktop cockpit for FB-000030 shows the Condition group with: Exterior 7/10, Interior 6/10, Tyres 5/10, Windscreen 'Chip Repairs', Accident Damage 'Yes' (rgb(255,77,109) red), Damage Types 'Cosmetic, Glass' (red), Paint Evidence 'Yes' (red), Paint Quality 'Fair'. Mobile /vehicle/[id] on the same submission also renders all 4 new rows with matching colours (verified DOM). Regression pytest run for dealer-photos suite (from prior iterations) = 22/22 PASS — no regressions. Legacy Chip/Crack windscreen values are still accepted by the backend Literal so seeded FB-000001/FB-000002 remain valid.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — same warnings noted in iteration_12, not introduced by this UX overhaul. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/MonthYearPicker.tsx uses `pointerEvents="none"` (line 104) which may contribute to the pointerEvents warning.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Submit-Vehicle UX overhaul is fully verified end-to-end. Backend accepts new fields (paint_quality Excellent|Fair|Poor|null, accident_damage_types subset, windscreen_condition Perfect|Chip Repairs|Needs Replacement + legacy Chip|Crack). Coercion works: paint_quality forced to null when paint_evidence=false; accident_damage_types forced to [] when accident_damage=false. GET /api/submissions/{id} returns the new fields. Frontend RatingDots default to null (3 'Not rated' badges), colour-coded correctly (red rgb(192,57,43), yellow rgb(212,172,13), green rgb(39,174,96)). WheelPicker for windscreen exposes only 3 modern options. MonthYearPicker (2-col scroll picker with monthyear-close/confirm/tbc testIDs) renders correctly and TBC sentinel returns as the string 'TBC'. Paint and Accident sub-panels correctly show/hide + clear selection on parent-toggle. Admin cockpit + mobile /vehicle/[id] show Accident Damage, Damage Types, Paint Evidence in red danger colour rgb(255,77,109) and Paint Quality plain. NOTE for next agent: test_billing_dealers.py is STALE — it uses the pre-schema payload (make_id/condition/etc.) and has 2 failures + 3 errors that predate this iteration; ignore or refactor. rating-N testIDs appear 3 times on the page — use `.nth(0/1/2)` (Exterior/Interior/Tyres). WheelPicker (windscreen) uses tap-to-select then explicit DONE, testID pattern wheel-{field}-done / wheel-{field}-cancel.
